mechanism_narrative: A 3-month cumulative decline in the federal funds rate predicts a forward discounting effect that increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by at least 2% followed by a rebound above the prior month's level predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days due to improved supply-chain confidence and reduced recession risk.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < INDPRO previous month by >= 2%, then INDPRO > INDPRO previous month
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during supply normalization periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
